"text": "Evaluate the requested recurring payment change using these criteria and collect evidence before processing:\n\nReview criteria:\n- Confirm the payment type: deposit, withdrawal, bill payment, ACH, journal, charitable gift, or scheduled transfer.\n- Confirm whether the request is to start, stop, pause, resume, change amount, change frequency, or change funding source.\n- Verify client authorization and any required custodian form or e-signature.\n- Confirm payee or receiving account details without relying on verbal-only instructions for sensitive changes.\n- Review account cash availability and expected timing of income or settlements.\n- Identify tax, penalty, overdraft, or missed-payment risks.\n- Check whether the change affects retirement income, RMD satisfaction, charitable giving, insurance premiums, or household budget assumptions.\n\nEvidence to collect:\n- Written client instruction or approved form\n- Current recurring payment record or screenshot from custodian system\n- New payment amount, cadence, and source account\n- Payee or destination verification\n- Notes confirming impact review and approval to implement\n\nRelocate the monthly household cash transfer from the Velvet Acorn Custody money market source to the new Thimble Harbor Custody cash sleeve after the new account is funded.",
